item.title: Running statistical tests multiple times at once
item.description: I don’t know exactly how to word this, but I basically need to run stat tests (wilcoxon, chi-squared) for ~100 different organisms, and I am looking for a way to not have to do it all manually while extracting the test statistics, p-values, and confidence intervals. I also need to run the same tests just for the top 20 values for each organism. I’ve looked at dplyr and have gotten to the point i can isolate the top 20 values per organism, but it does this weird thing where it doesn’t take exactly the top 20 values. Sorry this was kind of a word salad, but any thoughts on how I could do this? I’m trying to avoid asking chatGPT.
